title: DPP Keystone
usedFor: Peer DPP profile (v2) — iron and steel, EPD, textile and construction terms.
source: Third-party vocabulary survey. The Keystone specification has not been read.
finding: A peer profile with no institutional standing behind it — neither a standards body nor a Commission programme. Useful as a gap-analysis input for the product groups it covers, which overlap ours in steel, textile and construction. It is not an authority to anchor to.
nextStep: Nothing until a term gap is being worked in one of the four overlapping product groups. Reading a peer's model to find what we have not modelled is legitimate; adopting its IRIs is not, unless it turns out to carry standing this survey missed.
